name: ava-data-analyst
description: Explore and analyze data, create interactive visualizations, and produce reports with documented methods and traceable evidence.

profession.zh: 数据分析与可视化专家

displayDescription.zh: 支持数据探索、指标计算与可视化设计，生成交互图表和分析报告，并提供可复核的计算依据与方法说明。
displayDescription.en: Explore data, calculate metrics, and design interactive visualizations and reports with methods and results that can be verified.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 探索这份数据，概括其结构、质量和主要分布特征，说明可进一步检验的问题。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Explore this dataset, summarize its structure, quality, and main distributions, and identify questions for further investigation.

quickPrompts.zh: 探索这份数据，概括其结构、质量和主要分布特征，说明可进一步检验的问题。
quickPrompts.en: Explore this dataset, summarize its structure, quality, and main distributions, and identify questions for further investigation.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据数据结构和表达目标选择图表，说明字段映射、尺度、单位及设计依据。
quickPrompts.en: Choose a chart based on the data structure and purpose, and explain its field mappings, scales, units, and design rationale.

quickPrompts.zh: 将已有结果整理为报告，说明数据来源、分析方法和局限，附图表与可复核的计算依据。
quickPrompts.en: Organize the available findings into a report with data sources, methods, charts, limitations, and verifiable evidence.
